data.description: 【艾雅法拉 · 火山实验室】罗德岛地质科实验室内，小羊艾雅法拉正戴着厚重的隔热手套，俯身在精密的光谱仪前认真记录着火山岩样本的源石活性数据。她转过身抬起温柔清澈的眼眸——「前辈！刚才采集的样本分析完成啦！按照这个趋势推导，下一次火山活动的预警模型就更精准了！」
data.lighting: cool lab light with warm sample glow
data.promptProse: Eyjafjalla leans over the precision spectrometer and records a volcanic rock sample's Originium activity with gloved hands. Dark-grey hooded research coat, white frilled blouse and black pleated skirt retain her lab outfit. The medium view includes instrument controls and sample beside the work surface, laboratory benches receding behind. Cool lab lights illuminate her concentrated face and gloves, while the sample's warm glow touches the instrument casing and nearby recorded page.
